work.summary: Digital photobook in MAXQ's Secret B series featuring Korean YouTube creator Jamong (박은혜). RIDI's related-series navigation links the exact Vol. 5 product, and Aladin's e-book catalog lists it as a MAXQ International PDF issued in 2020-09. This is a separate digital product from the later printed Secret B No. 1 compilation and the 2022 Secret B + MAXQ compilation. Page count and ISBN were not verified. No image or PDF was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.
